cross_component_finding: None found beyond what the Capella twin and the fts:/search: registry state already established.
cross_product_finding: This is the measured 0.44-similarity twin of cloud/search/create-search-indexes.json, and the low score reflects real content divergence, confirmed here: (1) this server/ page documents the Quick Index editor (search:create-quick-index) as a distinct, named alternate creation path with its own edit-compatibility rules relative to the standard editor - the Capella extraction records no equivalent Quick Editor concept for its create-search-indexes page; (2) this page adds REST-API-specific scoped-naming detail absent from the Capella extraction ('you must use bucket.scope.index_name as the format for your index name with the analyzeDoc endpoint, but not with the new 7.6 query endpoint'); (3) despite the divergence, the two pages independently state the identical index-name-uniqueness rule gated at the identical version:server-7-6 threshold, and both independently gate synonym-collection support at version:server-8-0 - the shared cross-product concepts (search:index-name-uniqueness, search:synonym-source, search:customize-index, search:index-aliases, search:run-searches, search:search-index-params, search:create-search-index-ui, search:import-search-index) all reused cleanly with no conflict.
